header.title: General Settings
header.subtitle: Global application configuration and appearance settings

workingDir.label: Working Directory
workingDir.tooltip: Specify the directory used for storing entity specific working data and temporary files.

dataDir.label: Data Directory
dataDir.tooltip: The primary directory for persistent data, including themes and application state.

databaseFile.label: Database File
databaseFile.tooltip: The filename of the SQLite database within the data directory.

authEndpoint.label: Auth Endpoint
authEndpoint.tooltip: Web URL for Harmony.AI's authentication service. Required for using our cloud services.
authEndpoint.tooltipDisabled: Changing this field is disabled if the cloud features are turned off.

userApiKey.label: User API Key
userApiKey.tooltip: Personal API Key of your user Account. Also stored in file 'harmony-user.key'.
userApiKey.tooltipDisabled: Changing this field is disabled if the cloud features are turned off.
userApiKey.tooltipCautionText: Changing this value to a wrong one and saving can result in losing access to online features provided by Harmony.AI.

useHarmonyCloud.label: Use Harmony Cloud
useHarmonyCloud.tooltip: Whether Harmony Link should authenticate with the Harmony.AI cloud upon startup.
useHarmonyCloud.tooltipRestart: Cloud Services like Speech Engine can only be used when authenticated. (Requires restart to apply)

confirmEvents.label: Confirm Events
confirmEvents.description: Send confirmation events for each received event
confirmEvents.tooltip: Whether Harmony Link should send confirmation events for each event it receives.
confirmEvents.tooltipDebug: (Useful for Debugging or in stateful contexts)

logFile.label: Create Log File
logFile.description: Write detailed log file to disk (requires restart)
logFile.tooltip: Whether Harmony Link should write a log file while running.

connectionPort.label: Connection Port
connectionPort.tooltip: Port on this machine which Harmony Plugins can to connect to.

websocketBuffer.label: WebSocket Buffer (Bytes)
websocketBuffer.tooltip: If using WebSocket, this defines the message buffer size in Bytes. Connecting WebSocket Clients need to match this value.
websocketBuffer.tooltipFix: If you're running into issues with broken WebSocket Messages, increasing this value might fix it.

wssPort.label: WSS Port
wssPort.tooltip: The port used for secure WebSocket (WSS) connections. Disabled when Single Port Mode is active.

singlePort.label: Single Port Mode
singlePort.description: Serve WS and WSS on the same port (requires restart)
singlePort.tooltip: When enabled, both plain WebSocket (WS) and secure WebSocket (WSS) connections are served on the same port. The server automatically detects TLS connections and handles them accordingly.
singlePort.tooltipTunnel: Useful when using TCP tunnels (e.g. ngrok) for remote debugging — only one tunnel needed. (Requires restart to apply)

fontScale.label: Font Size / Scale
fontScale.tooltip: Adjust the interface font scaling. Compact reduces UI size, Large increases readability.

appLanguage.label: App Language
appLanguage.tooltip: Select the display language for the application interface.

numberFormat.label: Number Format
numberFormat.tooltip: Choose the decimal and thousands separator style for numeric displays.

dynamicBackground.label: Dynamic Background
dynamicBackground.description: Ambient stars, orbs, and cursor-following aura on all pages.
dynamicBackground.auraDescription: Soft glow that follows your cursor on every background style.

autoUpdate.label: Auto-Update Checks
autoUpdate.tooltip: Control how the application handles automatic update checks.
autoUpdate.tooltipNotify: "Notify Only" will alert you without installing.

soundEffects.label: Sound Effects
soundEffects.description: UI interaction clicks, success & alert chimes
